activity_summary: After Richard the Third you put forty-odd clean leaves into Garnish's hands. He read standing and found Katharine and Rosaline with the same lover. You chose. Rosaline keeps Berowne and Katharine keeps Dumaine. Heminges wrote one line, Navarre ended this day. Pope asked whether a reward was the point, and you kept the plain refusal. The seven shillings are Friday's, and they are the company's. No part was given out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Chose the two ladies, kept the plain refusal, and gave out no part.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Read standing, marked the fault, and kept the book.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked the length, wrote the one line, and named the fee as the company's.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Asked about the reward and did not take a roll.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Shall he woo them both, or will you choose?
